title: A Global Phase 3 Open-Label Extension Study to Assess AOC 1001 in Patients with DM1
official: A Global Phase 3 Open-Label Extension Study to Assess the Long-Term Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of Intravenous AOC 1001 for the Treatment of Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability of AOC 1001 in DM1 patients
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Ability to provide written informed consent (signed and dated) and any authorizations required by local law and be willing and able to comply with all study requirements. When enrolling participants who are minors, it is necessary to also obtain consent from a legally authorized representative and the participant will receive information in a way adapted to their age and mental maturity.
2. 2. Completion of any prior AOC 1001 studies with satisfactory completion of dosing and follow-up assessments and satisfactory compliance with the protocol requirements of the parent study, as determined by the Investigator.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Females who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the study period.
2. 2. Unwilling to comply with contraceptive requirements.
3. 3. Any new conditions or worsening of existing condition that in the opinion of the Investigator would make the participant unsuitable for the study.
